general.openAtLoginDesc: Runs in the menu bar only, so connection requests can be approved right away.
general.loginItemsApproval: Also allow it in System Settings › Login Items.
general.connectionRequestsDesc: Always on, as they need your approval
general.agentQuestionsDesc: Expire after 30 minutes if no one answers
general.menuBadge: Show a dot on the icon when something needs you

update.title: Updates
update.autoDownloadDesc: Once downloaded, they install when Hermesh quits or restarts

account.removeDeviceMessage: It can no longer approve anything, starting now, and its own machine is removed too. The machines and personal agents it approved are signed again by this Mac and keep working (requires Touch ID).
account.signOutRemovedMessage: This Mac is no longer in your Hermesh account and can’t approve anything. After signing out, you can set it up again or join your account again.
account.signOutFirstMessage: It’s still one of your trusted devices. First, on another of your trusted devices, remove it in Settings › Account & Devices: it then can’t approve anything, and as a machine it disconnects. Then sign out here.
account.devicesNote: Every trusted device can approve connection requests. If a device is lost, remove it on another.
account.consoleDesc: See machines and access in any browser, revoke in an emergency

grants.note: Access decides which of your projects, machines and coding agents an agent can use, and for how long.
grants.disconnectMessage: It loses access right away; its running sessions are interrupted, and the sessions themselves are kept. To use it again, connect it again.
grants.disconnectedOffline: Disconnected “{{name}}”; {{machines}} offline, takes effect once back online
grants.allMachinesLater: All machines (including ones that join later)

machines.shareDesc: Hermesh runs them from the command line as you would, without reading API keys or tokens. Turning this off stops the sessions here; turning it on requires Touch ID.
machines.renameMessage: Agents find projects by “machine/project”, so after renaming they see the new name. Use only lowercase letters, digits and -.
machines.removeMessage: This machine disconnects right away, and its running sessions stop. To join again, it needs to pair again.
machines.offlineAgents: The machine is offline; shown once it connects
